arguments.body:
State: queue work is complete per the user's update. The settled approach is repartitioning by the higher-cardinality key; consumer autoscaling stays off. Scaling consumers briefly helped and then increased contention on the same partition; the partition key concentrated evening traffic onto one partition.
Blockers: no queue-specific blockers or open tasks are recorded. Unrelated project notes are not resolved by this completion update.
Next concrete step: hand the completed queue work and its saved decision/evidence to the incoming owner. No further queue implementation task is asserted here; deployment and post-change validation details were not supplied.

arguments.name: queue-repartitioning-rationale
arguments.summary: The final decision is repartitioning by a higher-cardinality key with autoscaling off. The original evening backlog led to a consumer-scaling trial that briefly helped but increased contention. Diagnosis identified concentrated traffic on one partition. These historical observations support the decision; the user now reports the queue work complete. No post-change performance result is recorded.
